channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: CEE FX: Geopolitics drives rates and currencies – ING
item.description: ING strategist Frantisek Taborsky highlights easing Romanian inflation driven mainly by base effects, with the National Bank of Romania unlikely to cut rates before early 2027.

item.title: Euro remains subdued following German inflation data
item.description: EUR/USD extends its losses for the third successive day, trading around 1.1540 during the European hours on Wednesday. The pair holds losses as the Euro (EUR) remains weaker following the release of Germany’s Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) data.

item.title: British Pound advances to two-week high as rate gap and fiscal woes undermine Yen
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross climbs to a nearly two-week high, around the 215.35-215.40 area, during the first half of the European session on Wednesday and looks to prolong its recent solid recovery from the lowest level since early March, touched last week.

item.title: British Pound: Limited upside within defined band against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that GBP/USD closed marginally higher near 1.3510, with price action confined to a narrow 1.3493–1.3515 range. Intraday, they see scope for the Pound to edge higher but still capped within 1.3490–1.3535.

item.title: Equities: AI earnings revive risk appetite after tech weakness - Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists note that United States (US) equities had a mixed session as Magnificent 7 weakness weighed on the S&P 500, even as the equal-weighted index reached a fresh record.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Nearing 0.5860 support area amid by risk-off markets, domestic politics
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) accelerates its reversal against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, weighed by cautious markets amid growing tensions in the Middle East and political uncertainty at home.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Constructive carry outlook with RBA on hold – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) kept rates unchanged at 4.35% but retained a modest tightening bias, with the Board having actively considered a hike.

item.title: Indian Rupee trades lower ahead of India-US CPI data
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its decline against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday as the former continues to face pressure due to surging oil prices.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Extends the range play near 0.7050; bulls await 50% Fibo. breakout
item.description: The AUD/USD pair prolongs its consolidative price move for the third straight day and trades around mid-0.7000s through the early European session on Wednesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Policy focus after intervention - MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Teppei Ino reviews recent USD/JPY price action following coordinated Japan-US intervention. The pair opened near 157.58, dropped toward 155.20 on official confirmation of joint action, then recovered and traded above 158 by 7 August.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Continues to remain flat ahead of US CPI data
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) remains in a limited range at around 1.3500 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: Forex Today: Crucial US inflation data to lift market volatility
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Wednesday, August 12:

item.title: US Dollar: CPI and Fed rhetoric in focus – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank analysts highlight cautious positioning in the Dollar ahead of July US CPI, with the Dollar Index steady near 99.83 and EUR/USD around 1.1540.

item.title: Euro trims losses against the British Pound following hot German inflation data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) has picked up from session lows against the British Pound (GBP) on Wednesday as hot German inflation figures have partially offset a mild risk-off sentiment, amid flaring tensions in the Middle East.

item.title: Euro: Upside capped by key resistance against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report EUR/USD holding near 1.1540 after a quiet session, with momentum indicators mostly flat. Intraday, they expect consolidation between 1.1530 and 1.1560, but a break above 1.1560 could trigger a quick move to 1.1580.

item.title: Gold pares intraday gains as Fed hike bets and Iran risks support USD ahead of US CPI
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trims a part of its intraday gains and trades below the $4,400 mark heading into the European session on Wednesday, still up 0.50% for the day.

item.title: Euro trades with caution against US Dollar in countdown to US CPI data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades marginally lower at around 1.1534 against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Steadies near 184.00 amid neutral bias
item.description: EUR/JPY moves little for the second successive day, trading around 183.90 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency cross is maintaining a mildly bearish near-term tone as it slips beneath the 50-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA) while holding above the shorter nine-day EMA.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Bulls retain control near 38.2% Fibo.; move beyond $83.00 awaited
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – attracts buyers for the third straight day and trades just below the $83.00 mark during the Asian session on Wednesday, close to a nearly two-week high set the previous day.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: United States Dollar Index rises to near 100.00 ahead of US inflation data
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is extending gains for the third successive day and trading around 99.90 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises to near $65.40 with US inflation in focus
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades 1.1% higher at around $65.40 during the Asian trading session on Wednesday. The white metal reflects strength ahead of the United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for July, which will be published at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Canadian Dollar eases from two-month high as USD preserves weekly gains ahead of US CPI
item.description: The USD/CAD pair ticks higher during the Asian session on Wednesday, snapping a three-day losing streak to the 1.3915 area or its lowest level since June 10. Spot prices, however, lack bullish conviction and trade around 1.3930, awaiting the release of the latest US inflation figures.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar struggles as US Dollar gains on Middle East uncertainty
item.description: NZD/USD continues its losing streak for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.5870 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground on increased safe-haven demand amid rising uncertainty surrounding Middle East peace talks.

item.title: Australian Dollar slips as US Dollar strengthens amid uncertainty over Fed outlook
item.description: AUD/USD depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 0.7060 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair loses ground as the US Dollar (USD) rises ahead of a crucial inflation report.

item.title: Japanese Yen slides to two-week low, seems vulnerable as USD stands firm ahead of US CPI
item.description: The USD/JPY pair touches a one-and-a-half-week high during the Asian session on Wednesday, with bulls now looking to build on the momentum further beyond mid-159.00s amid a supportive fundamental backdrop.

item.title: British Pound loses as rising US Dollar, geopolitical tensions weigh on sentiment
item.description: GBP/USD inches lower after remaining flat in the previous day, trading around 1.3500 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair continues to hold its losses as the US Dollar (USD) gains strength ahead of a crucial inflation report.

item.title: Experts split on whether next RBA move is a hike or cut amid energy risks
item.description: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) unanimously held rates at 4.35% in August, but major economic forecasters offer varying takes on what comes next:

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7882 vs. 6.7900 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7882 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7900 and 6.7430 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Euro consolidates below mid-1.1500s vs USD ahead of German HICP, US CPI
item.description: The EUR/USD pair struggles to gain any meaningful traction and holds steady around mid-1.1500s during the Asian session on Wednesday, within a familiar range held over the past week or so.
